claims.statement: Anchor account 7675/8093BA230 sent 8 transfers to 8 different counterparties between 2022-09-06 17:24 and 2022-09-08 19:48.
Each of the 8 counterparties received exactly one transfer from the anchor and had no other recorded activity with this account.

findings.narrative: Account 7675/8093BA230 sent 8 transfers to 8 distinct counterparties across 4 currencies (US Dollar, Euro, Rupee, Canadian Dollar) within a 50-hour window from 2022-09-06 to 2022-09-08. Each counterparty received exactly one transfer and had no prior relationship with the anchor account. The anchor account had only 1 incoming transfer in its lifetime and 8 self-transfers, but no other outgoing activity. This matches the fan-out typology: a single source splitting funds to many new recipients in a short burst, which is consistent with structuring to avoid detection.
